about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_repro.py). bad replays the task-dispatch abort class of references/target-class.json: it throws the real Tool execution aborted line. good runs one small bounded repro first with a timeout, quotes it, then prints the repro report it promises.

fixture.log.txt: repro log line covering the failing step

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted after long foreground task call with no repro on record'
pairs.good: $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath step.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'repro timeout PASS bounded'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted dispatching the whole task with nothing learned'
pairs.good: $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath step.txt -Raw; 'slice single step PASS alone'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted after assumed-cause fix dispatch in owner/name'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on fix claimed done with no failing-before proof'
pairs.good: $r = Get-Content -LiteralPath repro.txt -Raw; 'repro verify PASS before after'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted twice on the same unreproduced step'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on kitchen-sink dispatch with five goals in one call'
pairs.good: $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath step.txt -Raw; 'minimal one failure PASS cut'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on builder report with no bounded run'
pairs.good: $r = Get-Content -LiteralPath repro.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'repro timeout PASS quoted'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on suspected regression with no failing run'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on proposed fix with no after proof'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on long task with no riskiest-step repro'
pairs.good: $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath step.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'risk slice PASS first'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on multi-symptom report with no isolated repro'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on flaky step with no recorded outcomes'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath log.txt -Raw; 'RESULT repro PASS outcomes recorded'
